title: Initialize Docker Compose structure with Dockerfile, .dockerignore, and docker-compose.yml
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml defines services: app, db (postgres:16), nginx
Dockerfile uses Node 18+ with multi-stage build (deps, build, runner)
PostgreSQL 16 service has health check and persistent volume mounted
Dockerfile compiles Next.js with `npm run build` and runs with `next start`
completion_summary: Created Dockerfile (multi-stage Node 20 Alpine), docker-compose.yml (app/db/nginx services), .dockerignore; updated next.config.mjs with standalone output; updated .gitignore and .env.local.example
